fact: The Director General of Niger's National Police writes in 2019 that since the DACORE was inaugurated in September 2015, 100 operators have been trained and 26 WAPIS sites established in the town of Niamey and connected to the DACORE, with an operating budget for WAPIS and expansion of the network to sites in the regions still planned; the Gendarmerie's central files division in Niamey is a remote site.
title: WAPIS Newsletter No. 12
